column8: ∀ {cellId : ℕ} {head : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head} {records : List Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord}, Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.AdmittedHistory cellId head records → ∀ (author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId) (request : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Append) (height : ℕ) (transaction : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest), Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.admitAppend (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.headStore head) author request = Except.ok () → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.AdmittedHistory cellId (head.append (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.appendEntry cellId head { author := author, height := height, transaction := transaction, entry := request.entry })) ({ author := author, height := height, transaction := transaction, entry := request.entry } :: records)

Option Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Prev → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord → Prop := fun prev author r => r.WellFormed ∧ match prev with | Option.none => True | Option.some p => r.domain = p.domain ∧ r.epoch.toNat = p.epoch.toNat + 1 ∧ author = p.author

Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.HeadStore → Prop := fun store => match Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.headOf store with | Option.none => True | Option.some head => match head.binding with | Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding.topic stream => True | Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Binding.room => match head.last with | Option.none => True | Option.some entry => Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EntryOk entry.record

Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.admitAppend (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.headStore Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Example.cachedHead) Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Example.sequencer (Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.recordAppend (have __src := Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Example.record 5 16; { domain := ⟨8, of_decide_eq_true (id (Eq.refl Bool.true))⟩, epoch := __src.epoch, classId := __src.classId, n := __src.n, tickRoots := __src.tickRoots, absentCommit := __src.absentCommit })) = Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Refusal.foreignDomain

Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.admitAppend (Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.headStore Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Example.cachedHead) Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Example.sequencer { topic := [], payload := [], recipient := Option.none, ref := Option.none } = Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Refusal.kindMismatch
List Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord → Prop := fun x => List.brecOn x Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.HistoryLaw._f

Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord → Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord → Prop := fun prev cur => match Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic prev.entry.topic, Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic cur.entry.topic with | Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel d e, Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel d' e' => d' = d ∧ e'.toNat = e.toNat + 1 ∧ cur.author = prev.author | Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel d e, x => False | x, Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel d e => False | x, x_1 => True

∀ (store : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.HeadStore) (author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId) (request : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Append) (height : ℕ) (transaction : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest), Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.admitAppend store author request = Except.ok () → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EntryOk { author := author, height := height, transaction := transaction, entry := request.entry } ∧ ∀ (previous : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord), Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.lastRecord store = Option.some previous → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.LinkOk previous { author := author, height := height, transaction := transaction, entry := request.entry }

∀ (store : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.HeadStore) (author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId) (r : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord) (prev : Option Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Prev), Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.prevOf store = Except.ok prev → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.admitAppend store author (Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.recordAppend r) = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.checkRecord prev author r

∀ (store : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.HeadStore) (author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId) (r : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord) (prev : Option Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Prev), Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.prevOf store = Except.ok prev → (Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.admitAppend store author (Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.recordAppend r) = Except.ok () ↔ Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.ChannelLaw prev author r)

∀ {cellId : ℕ} {head : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Head} {records : List Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord}, Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.AdmittedHistory cellId head records → ∀ {i j : ℕ} {ri rj : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord} {di dj : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.U16} {e : UInt64}, records[i]? = Option.some ri → records[j]? = Option.some rj → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic ri.entry.topic = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel di e → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic rj.entry.topic = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel dj e → i = j

∀ (store : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.HeadStore) (author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId) (request : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Append) (previous : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord) (d : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.U16) (e : UInt64), Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.lastRecord store = Option.some previous → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic previous.entry.topic = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.ordinary → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic request.topic = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel d e → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.admitAppend store author request = Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Refusal.kindMismatch

∀ (records : List Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord), Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.HistoryLaw records → ∀ (i k : ℕ) {ri rj : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord} {di dj : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.U16} {ei ej : UInt64}, records[i]? = Option.some ri → records[i + k]? = Option.some rj → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic ri.entry.topic = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel di ei → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic rj.entry.topic = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel dj ej → ei.toNat = ej.toNat + k

∀ {first : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord} {rest : List Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord}, Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.HistoryLaw (first :: rest) → ∀ {domain : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.U16} {epoch : UInt64}, Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic first.entry.topic = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel domain epoch → ∀ (k : ℕ) {record : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord} {d : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.U16} {e : UInt64}, (first :: rest)[k]? = Option.some record → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic record.entry.topic = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel d e → epoch.toNat = e.toNat + k

∀ (prev : Option Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Prev) (author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId) (r : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord), Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.checkLink prev author r = Except.ok () ↔ match prev with | Option.none => True | Option.some p => r.domain = p.domain ∧ r.epoch.toNat = p.epoch.toNat + 1 ∧ author = p.author
Option Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Prev → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord → Except Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Refusal Unit

∀ (prev : Option Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Prev) (author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId) (r : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord), Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.checkRecord prev author r = Except.ok () ↔ Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.ChannelLaw prev author r
∀ {author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId} {r : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord}, r.WellFormed → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.checkRecord Option.none author r = Except.ok ()

∀ {p : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Prev} {author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId} {r : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord}, r.WellFormed → r.domain = p.domain → r.epoch.toNat = p.epoch.toNat + 1 → author ≠ p.author → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.checkRecord (Option.some p) author r = Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Refusal.foreignAuthor

∀ {p : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Prev} {author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId} {r : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord}, r.WellFormed → r.domain ≠ p.domain → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.checkRecord (Option.some p) author r = Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Refusal.foreignDomain

∀ {p : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Prev} {author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId} {r : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord}, r.WellFormed → r.domain = p.domain → p.epoch.toNat + 1 < r.epoch.toNat → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.checkRecord (Option.some p) author r = Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Refusal.epochGap

∀ {p : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Prev} {author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId} {r : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord}, r.WellFormed → r.domain = p.domain → r.epoch.toNat = p.epoch.toNat + 1 → author = p.author → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.checkRecord (Option.some p) author r = Except.ok ()

∀ (records : List Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord), Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.HistoryLaw records → ∀ {i j : ℕ} {ri rj : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord} {di dj : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.U16} {e : UInt64}, records[i]? = Option.some ri → records[j]? = Option.some rj → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic ri.entry.topic = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel di e → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic rj.entry.topic = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel dj e → i = j

∀ (store : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.HeadStore) (author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId) (request : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.Append) (previous : Minidregg.Compiler.StreamCell.StreamRecord) (d : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.U16) (e : UInt64), Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.lastRecord store = Option.some previous → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic request.topic = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.ordinary → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.classifyTopic previous.entry.topic = Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.TopicClass.channel d e → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.admitAppend store author request = Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Refusal.kindMismatch

∀ {p : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Prev} {author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId} {r : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord}, r.WellFormed → r.domain = p.domain → r.epoch.toNat ≤ p.epoch.toNat → Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.checkRecord (Option.some p) author r = Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Refusal.epochNotAfter

∀ {author : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId} {r : Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.EpochRecord} {P : Minidregg.Theory.Channel.Profile}, Minidregg.Theory.Channel.profileOfId r.classId = Option.some P → r.tickRoots.length ≠ P.E → ∀ (prev : Option Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Prev), Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.checkRecord prev author r = Except.error Minidregg.Kernel.DomainEpoch.Refusal.rootCount
